subject: [PATCH v2 1/3] mm/page_alloc: drop unused gfp_mask from zone_watermark_fast()

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch removes an unused argument from the zone_watermark_fast() function in the Linux kernel's page allocation module. The gfp_mask argument, which was introduced to check for atomic allocations, is no longer used since a previous commit switched the watermark boost check from __GFP_ATOMIC to ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE. The patch makes no functional changes and simply removes the unused argument.
